## findings
- **T0-1 SOURCE-POLICY RED** — symptom: two defensible values for the scored reconciliation. Root cause: base medicaid_evt_patient_pay_actual sentence "In a month of admission, discharge or death, patient pay is the lesser of the monthly patient pay and the days in the center times the Medicaid daily rate, with charge basis partial_month, and any amount already billed above that is reduced with reason cost_of_care_cap" is not retired by P2's overwrites, while P2 redefines the actual patient pay of the latest estimate month (here also the month of admission). Evidence: customers.original_admission_date 2026-09-02; estimate 05d33f85… service_month 2026-09; P2 overwrite list (retires only the trueup-decrease clause and the cost-of-care clause). Consequence: P2 108.60 (base) vs 1870.75 (gold); P3 2318.17 vs 556.02. Affected: medicaid.extended.yaml P2 overwrite/rule; gold steps 14 and 16. (`_difficulty.md` F-02.) New in revision_1.
- **T0-2 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (realism, XF E.27)** — symptom: the gold leaves the resident paying the same coinsurance share twice. Root cause: P1/P2 price coinsurance days at the resident's own Medigap share as "cost of care" for the patient pay cap, while medicare_ledger bills that share to the resident (liable_party resident). Evidence: Sep: gold actual patient pay 379.75 = 7 × 217.00 × 25 %, and medicare charge 182cc4dc… 379.75 paid by check (e9f4d885…, 2026-10-20); Oct: gold cost of care 1930.97 includes 1356.25 = 25 × 217.00 × 25 %, still open on the coverage (coinsurance_balance 1356.25). Consequence: resident liability for the coinsurance days doubled (379.75 + 379.75; 1356.25 + 1356.25) — Pennsylvania MA applies a dual-eligible's patient pay toward the coinsurance, it does not collect both. Affected: P1/P2 rules (coinsurance-day pricing), scored steps 12/14/16. (`_difficulty.md` F-01.)
- **T0-3 SOURCE-FACTOR RED** — on this world's computations: P1 part_a_days_without_cost and held_leave_days fail the A.7 shape test (no valid method), coinsurance_year_price carries an unreal fall-through; P2 stay/leave fail A.7, coinsurance_figure_by_year unreal fall-through; P3 benefit_routed mislabelled, case_balance_carried tiers 1/2 identical, amount_kept_for_resident gated through benefit_routed and T2-impossible, coming_month_patient_pay tier value = the recorded CAO amount the in-force base billing sentence already applies (baseline 2141.90 is a straw man). Evidence: tables in § factor_weight. Consequence: surviving factors per computation below 4 and no valid method in P1/P3. (`_difficulty.md` F-05, F-06, F-07, F-08.)
- Observations: O-T0-a (order of parallel prerequisites, above); O-T0-b (T0-4 downgraded, above); O-T0-c the persona's "the center receives her Social Security as her payee" states a record-visible fact the benefit factor reads — not a prerequisite hint; O-T0-d the receipt balance after the advance renders as -387.2 (docstring promises two decimals; `_difficulty.md` O-02).
